title: FBI and EPA say water and wastewater utilities in at least seven states reported cyberattacks this week, with some causing flooding and other operational issues (James Rundle/Wall Street Journal)
summary: James Rundle / Wall Street Journal: FBI and EPA say water and wastewater utilities in at least seven states reported cyberattacks this week, with some causing flooding and other operational issues — Water plants in at least seven U.S. states have reported attacks this week, with some affecting operations
